visual_action: The video is a montage of US Men's National Soccer Team (USMNT) footage. It opens with a player in a black VW-sponsored training kit looking up at the sky on a sunny practice field, with a semi-transparent ghost image of the Statue of Liberty composited over the scene. Subsequent shots show players on the training pitch passing, dribbling, and kicking balls — still with the translucent Statue of Liberty overlaid and the word "FREEDOM" in large blue block letters. The scene then shifts to match footage: a packed stadium crowd waving red/white American flags, signage reading "Send-Off Match," Coca-Cola branding, and "United States" vs. "Germany" scoreboard graphics. A player does a celebratory flip/somersault on the pitch with crowds celebrating behind "Deutschland" advertising boards. A fan section shot shows young fans leaning over barriers reaching toward players. The final shots show a bald eagle composited into a match scene, with players in white USMNT kits on the field, a goalkeeper in yellow, and "Nike Soccer" signage visible behind the goal. American flag-like color washes (red, blue, orange) are layered over several shots. Throughout, single white serif words ("give," "give me," "take," "see") appear as lyric overlays in the center of the frame, building into the song's full phrase.
